classification.conclusion: The state-bound composite graph is not promotable unless its declared transition window survives third-and-later launches exactly and its capture-inclusive wall beats eager. Per-generation recapture remains a separately measured conservative fallback.

workload.route: repacked WMMA bulk prefill + GEMV decode; per-layer MoE graph off

graph_key_contract.description: Backend/model/quant/KV/shape/layer/weight-role/route/buffer identity plus state generation. A state-generation-keyed cache intentionally misses after every token mutation.

correctness.protocol: Byte-exact FP32 hidden seed, every Conv/GDN state pair, all live BF16 K/V rows, and token after each launch versus current eager from the same resident session.

timing.protocol: Rotating same-session full runs after reset/prefill; stable relaunch includes one capture/instantiate and final destroy per window, while recapture includes those costs per token.
